YUWANCARD-显示设置.title: Display Settings
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_DEATH_EFFECT.title: Enable Death Effect
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_DEATH_EFFECT.hover.desc: Play death effect when creatures are killed.
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_CUSTOM_CURSOR.title: Custom Cursor
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_CUSTOM_CURSOR.hover.des: Replace the game's default cursor with a pig-themed cursor.
YUWANCARD-CURSOR_SCALE.title: Cursor Scale
YUWANCARD-CURSOR_SCALE.hover.title: Cursor Scale
YUWANCARD-CURSOR_SCALE.hover.desc: Size of the custom cursor; 1.0x is roughly the vanilla 64px.
YUWANCARD-多人游戏设置.title: Multiplayer Settings
YUWANCARD-BYPASS_MODEL_DB_HASH_CHECK.hov: Allow players with different ModelDb hashes to connect. Warning: May cause game sync issues, ensure all players have the same mods.
YUWANCARD-更新设置.title: Update Settings
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_AUTO_UPDATE_CHECK.title: Enable Auto Update Check
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_AUTO_UPDATE_CHECK.hover: Automatically check for mod updates when the game starts.
YUWANCARD-游戏设置.title: Gameplay Settings
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_SEVEN_CURSES_RING.title: Enable Ring of Seven Curses
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_SEVEN_CURSES_RING.hover: Allow selecting the Ring of Seven Curses at the start of the run.
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_WHAT_IF_RELICS.title: Enable What-If Relics
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_WHAT_IF_RELICS.hover.de: Allow selecting What-If series relics at the start of the run.
YUWANCARD-ENABLE_MALICE_SELECTION.title: Malice Selection
Show the malice difficulty selection panel on the character select screen.
YUWANCARD-UPDATE_POPUP.title: YuWanCard Update Available
YUWANCARD-ANALYTICS_POPUP.title: YuWanCard Anonymous Analytics
YUWANCARD-ANALYTICS_POPUP.body:
This mod can anonymously collect the following data to understand feature usage and character performance:

- Mod launch count
- Anonymous unique install identifier
- Selected character at run start
- Singleplayer or multiplayer
- Ascension level
- Victory or defeat result
- Run duration
- Mod version

It does not collect player names, chat content, or other directly identifying personal information.

Do you want to enable anonymous analytics?
